summary: the first model review: rules name model roles and one table maps them to models, with the strongest model as a third tier used only on request; helper agents read the App profile themselves when it is not in their context
appCreator: The Project instructions and CLAUDE.md name roles (the standard thread model, the review model, the strongest model) instead of model names; the Models table in harness-sync/harness.md says which model each role is. Asking for the strongest model now has one meaning, and it runs only when you or a plan ask for it.
The planner, reviewer and qa agents read the App profile in CLAUDE.md themselves whenever it is not already in their context, so a plan or a QA pass can no longer run without the app's domain rules.
